# Class `puc::timer::Deadline`

Track one one-shot deadline against an injectable monotonic clock.

Arming replaces any previous deadline. `take_if_due()` consumes an elapsed deadline exactly once, which makes the type suitable for polling loops.

[Source](../../utils/timer/deadline.hpp#L21)
